name: dsh-bot-team
description: Bot Team: single chats and multi-agent group chat for DeepSeek Harness. Every bot gets a direct chat; create groups/topics, organize them into collapsible custom folders with drag ordering, add full-capability bot agents (files, search, web, workspace, commands) with their own model and BOT.md persona/working rules, @mention them to assign tasks, review each other's work, and run multi-round discussions.
author: shper

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && for f in host/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
